career.summary: Results-oriented Senior Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling resilient web applications and microservices. Expert in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and cloud native architectures. Proven record of mentoring engineering teams, cutting infrastructure latency by 35%, and driving user growth from seed to Series B.

experience.responsibilities:
Architected and spearheaded the migration of a monolithic web platform to a micro-frontend React/Next.js architecture with Node.js and GraphQL services.
Optimized high-traffic PostgreSQL queries and Redis caching, cutting P99 API response times by 42% for 200,000+ daily active users.
Led a sprint team of 6 engineers, standardizing TypeScript practices, CI/CD GitHub Actions, and automated Cypress test suites.

Developed mission-critical cloud management dashboard components in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Engineered event-driven asynchronous microservices using Express, Kafka, and Docker, handling 1.5M daily events with 99.98% uptime.
Collaborated with product managers to deliver 14 high-priority client features ahead of schedule.
